## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL regime. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: shallow sector breadth (3/11) and concentrated cyclical/energy leadership vs. megacap tech exhaustion — mixed signals support NEUTRAL; Leadership: Narrow (4/5 in Utilities & Industrials); Style: Value/Cyclical.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: XOM (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +5.74% | 1M: +10.48%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities strong: VST (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +4.06%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +9.46% | 1M: +1.98%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND, HON (1W: +8.81% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology lagging: GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +9.30%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -4.87% | 1M: +2.04%) CORRECTION. Communication weak: TMUS (1W: -11.63% | 1M: -7.67%) BELOW TREND, CMCSA (1W: -9.05% | 1M: -2.55%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary weak: TSLA (1W: -18.25% | 1M: -16.23%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: VST (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +4.06%) ABOVE TREND; LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND; CEG (1W: +9.46% | 1M: +1.98%) ABOVE TREND; HON (1W: +8.81% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND; FCX (1W: +8.44% | 1M: -1.16%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 in Utilities & Industrials) — concentrated cyclical strength.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: META (1W: -8.79% | 1M: +7.81%) CORRECTION; GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND; NOW (1W: -11.60% | 1M: -4.17%) BELOW TREND; TMUS (1W: -11.63% | 1M: -7.67%) BELOW TREND; ISRG (1W: -17.48% | 1M: -17.65%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in big-cap growth and select platform names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W momentum: VST (1W: +10.76%), LMT (1W: +10.72%), CEG (1W: +9.46%), HON (1W: +8.81%), FCX (1W: +8.44%). Note MAJOR divergence among megacaps (AAPL, MSFT, META with 1W ≠ 1M) — tactical volatility, watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed and under pressure with concentration of selling; NVDA (1W: +0.66% | 1M: +4.36%) ABOVE TREND while AAPL (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +9.30%) CORRECTION and MSFT (1W: -4.87% | 1M: +2.04%) CORRECTION; sector 1W: -3.49% — monitor for continuation of trend exhaustion.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Flattening internally: JPM (1W: +1.97% | 1M: +5.19%) ABOVE TREND but cards/payments names show mixed short-term weakness (V (1W: -3.71% | 1M: +7.04%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -3.85% | 1M: +8.83%) CORRECTION); sector 1W: -1.70% — selective strength, not broad.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Patchy: JNJ (1W: +3.72% | 1M: +8.44%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +0.04% | 1M: +3.50%) ABOVE TREND, but ISRG (1W: -17.48% | 1M: -17.65%) BELOW TREND signals idiosyncratic risk; sector 1W: -0.77%.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor exposure to Energy, Utilities and select Industrials (XOM, CVX, LMT) given clear 1W and 1M confirmation; reduce exposure to large-cap tech names in CORRECTION (AAPL, MSFT, META) and monitor NVDA for leadership confirmation. Style: Value/Cyclical over Growth while breadth remains narrow.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND; XOM (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND; AMD (1W: +7.74% | 1M: +3.82%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: GOOGL (1W: -10.37% | 1M: -8.22%) BELOW TREND; META (1W: -8.79% | 1M: +7.81%) CORRECTION; TSLA (1W: -18.25% | 1M: -16.23%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (Breadth positive; XOM/COP/OXY ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Technology and Communication (1W weakness concentrated in large caps). Monitor Industrials for follow-through from earnings/beat-driven moves.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch NVDA (1W: +0.66% | 1M: +4.36%) ABOVE TREND — sustained weekly gains confirm tech resilience; AAPL (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +9.30%) CORRECTION — breach of recent weekly support would confirm trend break; XOM (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND — hold above this week's breakout to extend energy leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
LMT (+80): Lockheed beat-and-raise; price confirming — LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment and price aligned. BAC (+80) noted in news but dual-timeframe not provided in dataset here — monitor for confirmation.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
META (-45): negative headlines on energy/policy; price showing CORRECTION — META (1W: -8.79% | 1M: +7.81%) CORRECTION, news aligns with distribution. INTC (-45): flagged negative in headlines; dual-timeframe not in provided snapshot — watch for follow-through if price confirms.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime with Value/Cyclical style and constrained breadth (Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive). XOM (1W: +7.50% | 1M: +12.28%) ABOVE TREND, LMT (1W: +10.72% | 1M: +12.89%) ABOVE TREND and VST (1W: +10.76% | 1M: +4.06%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is major megacap divergence (AAPL (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +9.30%) CORRECTION, MSFT (1W: -4.87% | 1M: +2.04%) CORRECTION, META (1W: -8.79% | 1M: +7.81%) CORRECTION) and negative headlines around META — watch for trend breaks.
